scope: P1_SEEG_SEEG_fit.npz (primary) and P1_TI_SEEG_fit.npz (second session); SEEG only (EEG files out of scope for this task)

findings.detail: P1_SEEG_SEEG_fit.npz, P1_TI_SEEG_fit.npz and VepMrtrixLut.txt sha256 and byte size match data/wang-5367ef4-manifest.csv
seeg (163,1500)/(163,1650), gain (163,162), SC (162,162), ch_names (163,); SC, gain and ch_names byte-identical across both sessions; 162 regions = 162 LUT entries
symmetric, zero diagonal, range [0,1], 91% off-diagonal non-zero, no isolated region, no NaN
no NaN, no zero column; all entries positive (min 3.2e-7, max 30.37) - not a signed bipolar lead field as stored; construction undocumented
163 unique bipolar adjacent-contact names on 13 electrodes; no malformed label
time_steps uniform step 10 in both files (SEEG 5..14995, TI 10..16500); unit not stored, 100 Hz assumes ms. Stimulus content at 50 Hz (Nyquist) means the stimulation waveform is aliased/undersampled
not declared; simulated arbitrary units. Channels carry large DC offsets (channel means -4.06..1.85) relative to fluctuations (median channel std 0.005 SEEG session)
no channel with std < 1e-6; lowest-std channels PFG'3-4 (2.2e-4), PI'5-6, PFG'2-3, GC'6-7, B'7-8 in SEEG session - low-gain contacts, signal near-constant
at most 2 samples per channel at the channel min/max; no plateaus

no exact repeated samples in any channel (no zero-padding). But the last ~5 s (SEEG) / ~6 s (TI) are a near-stationary decaying tail (mean |diff| ~3-4e-6); these segments carry almost no information and will dominate a naive per-sample likelihood
largest single-sample steps occur at stimulation onset (0.78 on GL'11-12 at sample 50, SEEG; 2.68 on CU'11-12 at sample 49, TI); these are stimulation artifacts, not file discontinuities

SEEG session: stimulation block ~0.41-3.59 s, then ~7.6 Hz rhythmic episode ~3.6-8.3 s. TI session: stimulation ~0.41-6.61 s (5 Hz envelope), then rhythmic episode ~7.7-10.1 s. Derived from the signal only; no annotation file
only ~0.4 s (40 samples) of pre-stimulation baseline in each session
no MRI, no electrode coordinates, no transform chain in the dataset; region-channel link is the gain matrix only

20/162 regions have any contact above 25% of global max |gain|; 6 have >=3 such contacts: Left-Supramarginal-posterior (5 contacts, max 30.4), Right-Intraparietal-sulcus (3 contacts, max 21.2), Left-O1 (4 contacts, max 18.9), Left-T2-anterior (3 contacts, max 18.6), Left-Superior-parietal-lobule-P1 (6 contacts, max 17.4), Left-Angular-gyrus (5 contacts, max 14.2). Implantation left-dominant (left mean max gain 3.95 vs right 1.27); frontal/PreSMA regions essentially unsampled

missingness.stimulation_parameters_and_generating_pa: not_accessible (reserved files, not opened by design)

suitability_for_synthetic_benchmark: SC and gain are complete and coherent; suitable as the structural basis of a synthetic benchmark. Planting the EZ in a region with >=3 contacts above 25% of global max gain is recommended (list under PatientCase anatomy.seeg_coverage_per_region.well_sampled_regions_ge3_contacts). Frontal and right-hemisphere regions are poorly observed and would be weakly identifiable.
verdict_reasons: Simulated data: signal units and time unit not declared (100 Hz inferred from step 10, assuming ms).
No anatomy beyond SC/gain: no MRI, coordinates, or transforms.
Stimulation epochs are signal-derived only; stimulation parameters are reserved and not available.
Stimulus waveform undersampled at 100 Hz (50 Hz alias in SEEG session); short 0.4 s baseline; long near-stationary tails.
